svg.title: Selected work: SalesPulse AI (private): Sales communication platform: power dialer, AI voice agents, SMS and two-way CRM sync. 2 commits in the last 12 months.; AlphaVenue (private): Celebrations and venue platform: API, marketing site and a mobile app for couples and venue owners. 7015 commits in the last 12 months.; Elio (private): Marketplace connecting contractors, homeowners and vendors: projects, milestone quotes, scheduling, payouts. 55 commits in the last 12 months.; SocialSync (private): Self-hosted, queue-based social media manager for teams across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and YouTube. 59 commits in the last 12 months.; HRIA-DMS (private): Donation management for a humanitarian academy, with an offline-first desktop app in English and Urdu. 262 commits in the last 12 months.; Reveal Your Intentions (private): AI social-intelligence app that reads a situation and suggests how to respond. 0 commits in the last 12 months.; RestaurantOS (private): Multi-tenant restaurant operating system: POS, inventory, finance, HR and reporting, as 18 microservices. 841 commits in the last 12 months.; cursor-powered-up (open source): One clone, one install: spec-driven workflows, agent memory, CodeGraph and MCP wiring for Cursor and VS Code. 11 commits in the last 12 months.
